channel.title: The Hockey News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Hockey News (thehockeynews.com)

item.title: 'She's Irreplaceable': Canada Captain Poulin Suffers Injury Scare Ahead Of Huge Game
item.description: With Canada facing the United States on Tuesday, the biggest question will be about the status of their captain and top player, Marie-Philip Poulin.

item.title: Olympic Hockey: USA's Sanderson, Sweden's Raymond Among U-24 Players To Watch
item.description: Whether they're effective NHL players or youngsters trying to break out, these under-24 Olympic men's hockey players should be very entertaining to watch in Milan.

item.title: NHL Rumor Roundup: Canadiens Could Trade Patrik Laine, Plus Flames And Predators Buzz
item.description: Patrik Laine is expected to return to the lineup following the Olympic break, but the Montreal Canadiens could peddle him before the trade deadline. Meanwhile, trade rumors continue to swirl around the Calgary Flames and Nashville Predators.

item.title: Olympic Men's Hockey: Who Are The Favorites In Each Group? Which Games Are Must-Watch?
item.description: The 2026 Winter Olympics feature three groups in the men's hockey preliminary round. Whether you're a casual or hardcore fan, there are some must-watch games in the round-robin that should interest anyone.

item.title: Report Card On Last Year's Top NHL Rookies Shows Many Soaring, Some Slipping
item.description: Last year's Calder Trophy winner, Lane Hutson, has shown his rookie NHL season was no fluke, and Macklin Celebrini has dominated. Other players, such Matvei Michkov, have the sophomore slump.

item.title: Who Are The Best NHL Goalies At The 2026 Olympics?
item.description: Team USA's Connor Hellebuyck, Sweden's Filip Gustavsson and Canada's Logan Thompson are some of the NHL netminders to watch at the Olympics.

item.title: CHL Announces Top 50 Players Of The Last 50 Years – And Fans Can Help Choose The Order
item.description: The top 50 CHL players of the last 50 years include Wayne Gretzky, Sidney Crosby, Leon Draisaitl and Connor Bedard. Fans can vote on their top 10.

item.title: Olympic Men's Hockey: Czechia, Switzerland Aim To 'Poke The Bear' Vs. Canada
item.description: Czechia's players say they're excited for what could be the most difficult game of their career against Team Canada. Switzerland flag bearer Nino Niederreiter, meanwhile, says he wants to "poke the bear."

item.title: The Hockey News Big Show At The Games: USA Routs Canada In Women's Olympic Hockey
item.description: Andrew McInnis, Michael Augello and Chris Sinclair recap Team USA's commanding win over Canada, Sweden's women's team and final expectations for the men's tournament.

item.title: Olympic Men's Hockey Predictions: Who Wins Gold, Silver & Scores The Most Points
item.description: For BetMGM, Gary Pearson examines the men's hockey odds and predicts who will win gold, silver and the top scorer title.
